name: Love Academy
source:
Game tells the story of Mike, the new student at Academy of Lovely Arts. He joins one of the labs: drawing, painting, sculpting, digital media or photography where he meets his future love interests.

[From [url=https://crunchester.itch.io/love-academy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述了可爱艺术学院新生迈克的故事。他将加入素描、绘画、雕塑、数字媒体或摄影工作室中的一个，并在那里结识日后的恋爱对象。

[摘自[url=https://crunchester.itch.io/love-academy]itch.io[/url]]
